snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer The House of Toys - All Phases
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM https://store.steampowered.com/app/3321000/The_House_of_Toys/

Twitter: https://x.com/OldSchoolBros

The House of Toys is a mystery and horror game in which the player ventures into an old mansion filled with seemingly harmless, yet somewhat disturbing, toys. His mission is to explore each room, searching for clues to discover which of the toys is cursed. To free the soul trapped in this toy, the player must solve intricate puzzles, facing dark secrets and the house's sinister past. Each solved puzzle brings the protagonist closer to discovering the true origin of the curse.
